notes.text: Band 3 is the colophon line 'Zapisano ot chukchi ... osenyu 1897 g. na urochishche Sukharnom.', indented about like a paragraph start and ending short, directly under the text's last line. It opens no paragraph, so MainZone-Other may fit better; I left it because its indent matches an opener and no ruling names a colophon label.
